ACLPolicy.description: ACLPolicy is the access-control block of a policy.

allow_bypass_waf.description: AllowBypassWAF lets allow-listed clients skip WAF inspection. Off by default: an allow list skips rate limits and bot checks, not the WAF.

allow_lists.description: Names of ip_lists whose clients are allowed: they skip rate limits and bot checks. A list of names replaces the inherited list; {add, remove} edits it.

countries.description: Allows or denies clients by country, using the GeoIP database from feeds.geoip.

deny_lists.description: Names of ip_lists whose clients are blocked. A list of names replaces the inherited list; {add, remove} edits it.

password_gate.description: PasswordGate puts HTTP Basic authentication in front of the site.

reputation.description: Acts on clients listed by the reputation feeds.

ca.description: HTTPS URL of an ACME directory to use instead of Caddy's default certificate authorities (for example a private or staging CA).

email.description: Contact address sent to the certificate authority when ordering certificates; must contain an @. Optional.

APIMatch.description: APIMatch selects requests by path glob and method.

methods.description: Upper-case HTTP methods; empty means every method.

APIPolicy.description: APIPolicy configures the API module: OpenAPI conformance, JWT validation and mutual TLS. Every field is optional and inherits like the rest of a policy.

enabled.description: Turns API protection on (on by default whenever the block is present).

jwt.description: JWT rules are a list: a lower level replaces the whole list.

max_body_bytes.description: MaxBodyBytes bounds the request body read for schema validation; larger bodies are not validated (the finding says so).

mtls.description: Requires a verified client certificate on the listed paths.

openapi_doc_id.description: OpenAPIDocID refers to an uploaded OpenAPI document (3.0 or 3.1).

schema_violation_action.description: SchemaViolationAction applies to documented requests whose parameters or body break the schema: log (default) or block. Blocking needs openapi_doc_id.

unknown_path_action.description: UnknownPathAction applies to requests the document does not describe (path or method): log (default) or block. Blocking needs openapi_doc_id.

AccessLog.description: AccessLog is the optional sampled log of clean requests (FR-EVT-3).

enabled.description: Turns the sampled access log on (default false).

sample_rate.description: Fraction of clean requests logged, from 0 to 1 (default 0.01).

Admin.description: Admin configures the node's admin listener, which serves /metrics, /healthz and /readyz. It is separate from proxied traffic.

allowed_cidrs.description: Client addresses or CIDR ranges allowed to reach the admin listener; empty allows any client that can connect.

listen.description: Address of the admin listener as host:port, or "off" to disable it (default 127.0.0.1:9444).

AutoBan.description: AutoBan bans a client that keeps getting blocked.

ban_duration.description: How long the client stays banned, 1m to 30d.

blocks_threshold.description: Number of blocked requests within window that triggers a ban, 1 to 1,000,000.

enabled.description: Turns auto-ban on (on by default whenever the block is present).

window.description: Period in which blocks are counted, 1s to 24h.

BlockPage.description: BlockPage selects the page shown for terminated requests.

template_id.description: "default" or the id of an uploaded block page (default "default").

BotMatch.description: BotMatch selects requests; every set field must match.

countries.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country codes in capitals.

reputation.description: Reputation true matches clients on a reputation list.

BotPolicy.description: BotPolicy configures the bot module: challenge pages for suspicious clients. Every field is optional and inherits like the rest of a policy.

challenge.description: Challenge is pow (self-hosted proof of work), turnstile or hcaptcha. The provider secrets come from the environment (SHERLOCK_TURNSTILE_SECRET, SHERLOCK_HCAPTCHA_SECRET), never from the configuration.

clearance_ttl.description: ClearanceTTL is how long a passed challenge is remembered.

difficulty.description: Difficulty is the number of leading zero hex digits the proof of work needs (4 takes a browser well under a second).

enabled.description: Turns bot defence on (on by default whenever the block is present).

rules.description: Rules evaluated in order against each request; at most 50. A lower level replaces the whole list.

site_key.description: SiteKey is the public key of a turnstile or hcaptcha widget.

verified_bots.description: VerifiedBots says what to do with clients that claim to be a search engine and whose address checks out by reverse DNS: allow (default), challenge or block. Claims that do not verify are treated as ordinary clients.

BotRule.description: BotRule challenges (or blocks, or lets through) requests that match.

match.description: Which requests the rule applies to; every set field must match.

Countries.description: Countries allows or denies ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country codes.

list.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country codes in capitals, without duplicates; an empty list with mode allow is rejected because it would block every country.

mode.description: off, allow (only the listed countries) or deny (all but the listed countries); default off.

CrowdSecConfig.description: CrowdSecConfig connects to a CrowdSec local API as a bouncer.

allow_private.description: AllowPrivate lets the API live on a loopback or private address, which is where a local CrowdSec agent usually listens. Link-local addresses (the cloud metadata service) stay refused.

enabled.description: Turns the CrowdSec bouncer on (default false).

lapi_url.description: http or https URL of the CrowdSec local API; required when enabled. The API key comes from SHERLOCK_CROWDSEC_API_KEY.

DLPPattern.description: DLPPattern is a named custom detector. The pattern is a Go (RE2) regular expression, so it cannot cause catastrophic backtracking.

name.description: Name used in detect as custom:<name>: lower-case letters, digits and underscores, starting with a letter (at most 32).

pattern.description: RE2 regular expression, at most 512 characters, that must not match the empty string.

DLPPolicy.description: DLPPolicy configures the data-loss-prevention module (FR-FIN-2): it scans responses for card numbers, IBANs and custom patterns and masks or blocks them. Matched values are never written to events, logs or exports.

action.description: Action is mask (default), block or log. In detect mode a match is only recorded; the response is never changed.

content_types.description: ContentTypes is the allow-list of response media types that are scanned.

custom_patterns.description: Named custom detectors, at most 20; a lower level replaces the whole list.

detect.description: Detect lists what to look for: pan, iban, or custom:<name> for an entry of CustomPatterns. A list: a lower level replaces it.

enabled.description: Turns data protection on (on by default whenever the block is present).

max_body_bytes.description: MaxBodyBytes bounds how much of a response is scanned; a larger response is passed through untouched and counted as skipped.

Endpoint.description: Endpoint overrides the site policy for requests matching Match.

id.description: Lowercase slug that names the endpoint; unique within the site.

match.description: Which requests the endpoint applies to.

policy.description: Policy overrides for matching requests; unset fields inherit from the site.

EndpointMatch.description: EndpointMatch selects requests by exactly one of Path, PathPrefix or PathGlob (path.Match syntax), optionally narrowed to Methods.

methods.description: Upper-case HTTP methods the endpoint applies to; empty means every method.

path_glob.description: Path glob in path.Match syntax, starting with '/'.

access_log.description: The optional sampled log of clean requests, off by default.

body_excerpt.description: Records a redacted excerpt of the request body in events (default false).

node_name.description: Name stamped on every event so exports can tell nodes apart (default: the host name; at most 128 characters).

redaction.description: Extra redaction rules applied to events on top of the built-in ones.

retention_days.description: RetentionDays is how long stored events are kept (control-plane database only).

sinks.description: Where events are written on the node itself.

Exclusion.description: Exclusion removes CRS rules, tags or rule targets for requests that match Match. It compiles to a runtime exclusion rule placed before CRS (T1).

description.description: Why the exclusion exists, at most 500 characters.

id.description: Lowercase slug that names the exclusion; unique within a level.

match.description: Which requests the exclusion applies to; empty means all requests.

remove_rule_ids.description: CRS rule ids ("942100") or ranges ("942100-942199") that are not evaluated. Sherlock's own rules, virtual patches and custom rules cannot be removed here.

remove_tags.description: CRS rule tags whose rules are not evaluated.

remove_targets.description: Request targets removed from the checks of specific rules or tags.

ExclusionMatch.description: ExclusionMatch scopes an exclusion. Empty Paths means every path, empty Methods every method. Paths use path.Match globs ("*" does not cross "/"); a trailing "/**" matches the prefix and everything below it.

methods.description: Upper-case HTTP methods the exclusion applies to; empty means every method.

paths.description: Path globs the exclusion applies to; empty means every path.

ExclusionTarget.description: ExclusionTarget removes one request target (ARGS:q, REQUEST_COOKIES:/^_ga/) from the checks of the listed rules or tags.

rule_ids.description: Rule ids or ranges the target is removed from (give rule_ids or tags).

tags.description: Rule tags the target is removed from (give rule_ids or tags).

target.description: The request target to exclude, in CRS syntax such as ARGS:q, ARGS_NAMES:q or REQUEST_COOKIES:/^_ga/.

Feeds.description: Feeds configures the background data the node refreshes. Secrets are never part of the document: the MaxMind licence key and the CrowdSec API key come from the environment (SHERLOCK_MAXMIND_LICENSE_KEY, SHERLOCK_CROWDSEC_API_KEY).

crowdsec.description: Connection to a CrowdSec local API.

geoip.description: The country database used by country ACLs and rules.

reputation_lists.description: Public reputation lists to download: firehol_level1, spamhaus_drop.

auto_update.description: Downloads and refreshes the database automatically when it is missing or stale (default false: a database file placed in the data directory by hand is used as is).

Global.description: Global holds settings shared by every site.

acme.description: Settings for automatic certificates (sites with tls.mode acme).

admin.description: The admin listener that serves /metrics, /healthz and /readyz.

client_ip_headers.description: Headers read, in order, for the real client address when the request comes from a trusted proxy (default X-Forwarded-For when trusted_proxies is set).

defaults.description: A policy block applied to every site; sites and endpoints override it field by field.

events.description: The event pipeline: node name, retention, access log, redaction and sinks.

feeds.description: Background data the node downloads and refreshes: country database, reputation lists and CrowdSec.

ip_lists.description: Named lists of addresses and CIDR ranges that acl allow_lists and deny_lists refer to (at most 1000 lists and 1,000,000 entries in total).

trusted_proxies.description: Addresses or CIDR ranges of reverse proxies and load balancers in front of Sherlock whose client-address headers are trusted; empty means the client is the TCP peer and forwarded headers are ignored.

enabled.description: Sends Strict-Transport-Security on TLS sites (default true; only sent while headers.security_headers is on).

Headers.description: Headers controls response headers added by Sherlock.

security_headers.description: Adds X-Content-Type-Options, Referrer-Policy and, on TLS sites, Strict-Transport-Security to responses (default true).

HealthCheck.description: HealthCheck is an active upstream health probe; it is off when Path is empty.

path.description: Path requested on each target, starting with '/'; empty turns health checking off.

timeout.description: Time a probe may take; positive and not longer than interval (default 2s).

IPList.description: IPList is a named set of CIDRs referenced by ACL allow and deny lists.

cidrs.description: CIDR ranges or single addresses (IPv4 or IPv6).

name.description: Lowercase letters, digits, '-' or '_' (at most 63); unique.

JWTRule.description: JWTRule validates bearer tokens on the requests it matches. Keys come from exactly one of JWKSURL (fetched by a background job, never on the request path), PublicKeyPEM or HMACSecretEnv.

action.description: Action for a missing or invalid token: block (default) or log.

audiences.description: Accepted values of the token's aud claim, at most 20; the token must carry at least one.

clock_skew.description: ClockSkew tolerates small clock differences in exp/nbf (default 30s).

hmac_secret_env.description: HMACSecretEnv names the environment variable holding a shared secret. It is the only way to accept HS256/384/512 tokens.

issuer.description: Required value of the token's iss claim; set issuer or audiences (or both).

jwks_url.description: JWKSURL must be https and may not point at a private, loopback or link-local address (SSRF, threat T13).

match.description: Which requests the rule applies to (default all paths and methods).

optional.description: Optional lets requests without a token through; a token that is present must still be valid.

public_key_pem.description: PublicKeyPEM is a static RSA, ECDSA or Ed25519 public key.

refresh_interval.description: RefreshInterval is how often the JWKS is refetched (default 15m).

LoginEndpoint.description: LoginEndpoint is one login request: a path glob and method, where the username is in the request, and which upstream statuses mean "failed".

failure_statuses.description: FailureStatuses are the upstream statuses counted as a failed login (default 401 and 403).

username_field.description: UsernameField is a JSON pointer ("/user/email") for JSON bodies or a field name ("email") for form bodies. Usernames are only ever kept as a keyed hash.

LoginPolicy.description: LoginPolicy configures the login-protection module (FR-FIN-1): failed-login velocity per client address, per username and per device, answered with a challenge or a block. Every field is optional and inherits like the rest of a policy; Endpoints is a list, so a lower level replaces it as a whole.

action.description: Action is what happens to a client over a threshold: challenge (default), block or log. In detect mode it is recorded and never enforced.

enabled.description: Turns login protection on (on by default whenever the block is present, but nothing is watched until an endpoint is declared).

endpoints.description: Endpoints declares the login requests Sherlock watches. Nothing is watched until at least one is declared.

thresholds.description: Failures allowed per window before the action applies; unset values inherit.

LoginThresholds.description: LoginThresholds are the failures allowed per window before Action applies. A zero field inherits.

per_device.description: Failed logins per device fingerprint in the window, 1 to 100000 (default 10).

per_ip.description: Failed logins per client address in the window, 1 to 100000 (default 20).

per_username.description: Failed logins per username in the window, from any address, 1 to 100000 (default 5).

window.description: Period in which failures are counted, 1m to 24h (default 10m).

MTLSPolicy.description: MTLSPolicy requires a verified client certificate on the listed paths. The CA is an uploaded CA bundle; the site's TLS listener asks for a certificate (without insisting) and the API module enforces the paths.

ca_cert_id.description: Id of an uploaded CA bundle the client certificate must chain to; required when required_paths is set.

required_paths.description: Path globs (at most 50) on which a verified client certificate is required.

PasswordGate.description: PasswordGate configures the site password gate. PasswordHash is an argon2id PHC string (create one with `sherlock hash-password`); the clear password is never stored.

enabled.description: Turns the gate on (on by default whenever the block is present); needs username and password_hash.

password_hash.description: argon2id hash of the password, starting with $argon2id$; never returned by the API.

username.description: The accepted user name, at most 64 characters, without ':' or line breaks.

Policy.description: Policy is the protection block used at global, site and endpoint level (ADR-0012). Every field is optional; unset fields inherit.

acl.description: Access control: allow and deny lists, countries, reputation and the password gate.

api.description: API protection: OpenAPI conformance, JWT validation and mutual TLS.

auto_ban.description: Bans a client address that keeps getting blocked. There is no built-in default: set blocks_threshold, window and ban_duration together.

block_page.description: The page shown for requests Sherlock terminates.

bot.description: Bot defence: challenge pages for suspicious clients.

dlp.description: Data protection: scans responses for card numbers, IBANs and custom patterns and masks or blocks them.

fail_mode.description: What happens to a request when a protection module fails internally: open lets it through, closed refuses it (default closed in block mode, otherwise open).

login_protection.description: Login protection: failed-login velocity per client address, username and device on declared login endpoints.

mode.description: off turns inspection off, detect records what would be blocked without blocking, block enforces (default detect).

opt_out.description: OptOut removes inherited named items, written "rate_limits:<name>", "exclusions:<id>" or "virtual_patches:<id>". It is the only way to drop a global item (and is audited with the change).

rate_limits.description: RateLimits are named items: levels are unioned by name, and a lower level may replace an item that has the same name.

stacks.description: Stacks declares the technologies behind the site (wordpress, php, spring, ...). Product-specific virtual patches activate only for declared stacks. Unset means "auto": generic patches only.

virtual_patches.description: VirtualPatches switches the CVE rule pack (ADR-0013) per level.

limit.description: Requests allowed per window and key, 1 to 1,000,000.

match.description: Restricts the limit to matching requests; empty applies it to every request.

name.description: Lowercase letters, digits, '-' or '_' (at most 63); a lower level replaces an inherited limit of the same name.

window.description: Length of the counting window, 1s to 24h.

RateLimitMatch.description: RateLimitMatch narrows a limit to paths (path.Match globs) and methods.

methods.description: Upper-case HTTP methods; empty means every method.

paths.description: Path globs starting with '/' (at most 50); default ["/*"].

Redaction.description: Redaction adds operator patterns to the built-in ones.

patterns.description: Patterns match parameter names (case-sensitive RE2; use (?i) for case-insensitive).

enabled.description: Turns reputation checks on (on by default whenever the reputation block is present).

Root.description: Root is the whole configuration document.

global.description: Settings shared by every site: admin listener, trusted proxies, certificate authority, events, default policy, IP lists and feeds.

schema_version.description: Version of this document format; must be 1, the only version this build accepts (default 1 when omitted).

sites.description: The protected sites; at least one is required.

Sinks.description: Sinks selects the temporary event outputs used until the store exists.

file.description: Writes security events to events.jsonl (and the access log to access.jsonl) in the data directory, with rotation (default true).

file_keep.description: Number of rotated event files kept, 1 to 100 (default 5).

file_max_mb.description: Size in MiB at which an event file is rotated, 1 to 10240 (default 100).

stdout.description: Writes security events as JSON lines to standard output (default true).

Site.description: Site is one protected website or API.

hosts.description: Host names the site answers for: lowercase DNS names, optionally with a leading "*." wildcard, or IP addresses; at least one.

id.description: Lowercase slug (a-z, 0-9, '-', at most 63 characters) that identifies the site; unique.

name.description: Display name shown in the dashboard.

path_prefix.description: Serves only requests under this path (starts with '/', no '..'), so several sites can share a host; the longest prefix wins. Empty means the whole host.

policy.description: The site's protection policy; overrides global.defaults.

upstreams.description: The origin servers behind the site.

TLS.description: TLS configures a site's certificates and transport security. With mode "file" the certificate is either a pair of files on the node (CertFile and KeyFile) or an uploaded certificate (CertID); never both.

cert_file.description: Path on the node of the PEM certificate chain; with mode file, use cert_file and key_file together or cert_id.

cert_id.description: Id of an uploaded certificate; with mode file, use this instead of cert_file and key_file.

key_file.description: Path on the node of the PEM private key; used with cert_file.

mode.description: acme obtains certificates automatically, file uses certificates you supply, none serves plain HTTP only (default acme).

dial.description: Time allowed to connect to the origin (default 5s).

read.description: Time allowed to read the origin's response (default 60s).

write.description: Time allowed to send the request to the origin (default 60s).

UpstreamTLS.description: UpstreamTLS configures TLS towards the origin.

client_cert_id.description: Id of an uploaded certificate presented to the origin for mutual TLS; needs enabled.

enabled.description: Connects to the origin over TLS (default false).

insecure_skip_verify.description: Skips verifying the origin's certificate (default false). Leaves the connection open to interception: use for testing only.

Upstreams.description: Upstreams describes the origin servers behind a site.

health_check.description: Active health probe of the targets; off unless a path is set.

http_version.description: HTTPVersion pins the protocol spoken to the origin: "" (Caddy's default), "1.1", "2", or "h2c" (cleartext HTTP/2, which gRPC origins need).

lb_policy.description: How requests are spread over targets: round_robin, least_conn or ip_hash (default round_robin).

targets.description: Origin servers as host:port; at least one.

websockets.description: WebSockets allows connection upgrades through to the origin (default true). The WAF cannot inspect frames, so deny is the strict choice.

VirtualPatchPolicy.description: VirtualPatchPolicy enables the virtual-patch pack and lists patches to skip.

disabled.description: Disabled are patch ids (SV-2021-0001) switched off at this level; levels are unioned and a global entry is removed only through opt_out.

enabled.description: Turns the virtual-patch pack on or off at this level (default true).

blocking_paranoia_level.description: Paranoia level at or below which rules count towards blocking, 1 to 4; it must not exceed paranoia_level (default: the paranoia_level).

custom_rules.description: CustomRules is operator SecLang (ids 10000-99999) loaded before CRS. The lowest level that sets it wins; it is validated by customrules.

enabled.description: Turns the WAF on or off for this level (default true).

exclusions.description: Exclusions are named, scoped rule removals (false-positive tuning). Levels are unioned by id; a lower level replaces an item with the same id.

inbound_threshold.description: Anomaly score at which a request is blocked; at least 1 (default 5).

max_body_bytes.description: Largest request body in bytes that is inspected, 1 to 1073741824 (1 GiB); default 10485760 (10 MiB).

outbound_content_types.description: OutboundContentTypes are the media types whose responses are inspected (prefix match on the type, e.g. "text/" or "application/json").

outbound_inspection.description: Also inspects response bodies for data leaks and error pages (default false).

outbound_max_body_bytes.description: OutboundMaxBodyBytes bounds the response body kept for inspection when outbound_inspection is on; larger responses are inspected up to the limit.

outbound_threshold.description: Anomaly score at which a response is blocked when outbound inspection is on; at least 1 (default 4).

paranoia_level.description: CRS paranoia level, 1 to 4: higher levels enable more rules and produce more false positives (default 1).

skip_inspection_extensions.description: File extensions such as ".css" whose GET and HEAD requests skip body inspection (default: common static assets: css, js, images, icons and fonts).

description: Root is the whole configuration document.
title: Sherlock WAF configuration (schema_version 1)
